store.chain: PaperEntity -> SourceRecord -> AcquisitionRecord -> DocumentVersion -> immutable PDF blob
store.v1Migration: local-import becomes user-import; institution-download remains unknown until explicitly classified

routes.local: file-first user-selected PDF followed by explicit PaperEntity association
routes.institution: opaque SourceRecord ID opens its Rust-resolved official route in the shared institution session; a user-triggered completed PDF is then attached by opaque download ID with exact SourceRecord evidence match
routes.institutionSourceNavigation: frontend submits no URL; Rust resolves the exact SourceRecord, retains only non-sensitive navigation parameters, and exposes only origin plus path
routes.institutionFailureLedger: source-route, source-navigation, download-selection, and source-match failures create retryable per-paper AcquisitionRecords before immutable ingest

provenance.institutionSourceMatch: search candidate ID -> provider record ID -> sanitized canonical locator -> unique source database; unresolved is rejected

sampleSources: 国家哲学社会科学文献中心
readOnlyAcceptanceDatabaseProbe.scope: Read-only local database evidence only; it does not prove native source navigation, authenticated full-text access, download, or document attachment.

nativeUnverified: Choose one local PDF before selecting a paper, then explicitly associate it with the intended PaperEntity and verify SHA-256, immutable storage, native detail, and restart recovery.
Verify the local PDF AcquisitionRecord has no institution SourceRecord and that filename, directory, or PDF text never selects the PaperEntity.
Import the same PDF again and verify no duplicate blob or DocumentVersion.
Import different bytes for the same paper and verify a second version.
Open one imported paper source by opaque SourceRecord ID and verify the shared institution session reaches the exact official record or resolver without exposing a raw URL to React.
Explicitly download and attach one institution PDF through its opaque completed download ID, and verify it binds the exact imported SourceRecord or is rejected when no exact evidence match exists.
Force one unresolved or failed source navigation and verify a retryable source-route or source-navigation AcquisitionRecord survives restart without creating a DocumentVersion.
Verify source provenance contains no ticket, token, Cookie, username, or password.
Verify no Provider call, batch acquisition, hotspot rebuild, or unintended main-library mutation occurs.
